rows.grounds: object of installation; the supporting power serving as the starting point
indicates the sequence starting from the foundation-power
object to be placed; the practitioner's designated seat
refers to the previously prepared seat-place
prescribes the ritual act of installing the seat

items.question: From which foundational power must the practitioner install the designated seat in the prepared place?
premises: The seat-place has already been ritually prepared in the preceding steps.
The installation is prescribed to begin with the foundation-power.
The practitioner's own seat is to be placed in that prepared location.
items.inference: Therefore, the practitioner should install the designated seat there by starting the placement sequence from the foundation-power.
uncertainties: The specific identity or form of ādhāraśakti in this ritual context is not specified in this verse.
items.plain_english: Beginning with the foundation-power, one should place one's own seat there.
